get.summary: Returns the API build version and contract version.

put.summary: Sets the profile picture to a completed avatar upload. The previous picture is deleted.

delete.summary: Removes the profile picture; initials are shown instead.

post.summary: Joins a community using an invitation code.

get.summary: Lists channels the caller can view, ordered by type and position.

post.summary: Creates a text or voice channel. Requires ManageChannels.
Issues a short-lived SFU grant for a voice channel the caller may join. Requires ConnectVoice; screen-share sources are added with ShareScreen while the server has screen sharing on.
Issues a short-lived, hidden, subscribe-only SFU grant for watching screen shares in a voice channel. Same rights as joining; 403 voice.screen_share_disabled while the server has screen sharing off.

get.summary: Lists who is in each voice channel of a community the caller can view. Channels nobody is in are omitted.

put.summary: Marks a text channel read up to a message. Positions only move forward; the stored position is returned.

get.summary: Read position, newest message and unread count (capped at 100) of each readable text channel. History from before the caller joined counts as read.

post.summary: Creates an account and signs it in on this device.
Signs in with a username or email and password.
Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token.
Revokes every session of the current account.
Creates a private community owned by the caller, with a text channel `general` and a voice channel `General`.

get.summary: Lists communities the caller is an active member of.
Returns a community the caller is a member of.

patch.summary: Renames the community or changes its description. Needs ManageCommunity.

delete.summary: Deletes the community for everyone. Owner only; cannot be undone.

put.summary: Sets the community icon to a completed upload made for it. Needs ManageCommunity.

delete.summary: Removes the community icon. Needs ManageCommunity.

post.summary: Leaves the community. The owner cannot leave.
Creates an expiring invitation. The code is returned only once.

get.summary: Returns a channel the caller can view.

patch.summary: Renames, re-topics or moves a channel. Position is its zero-based place among channels of its type; the others shift. Requires ManageChannels.

post.summary: Posts a message in a text channel. Resending the same clientMessageId returns the original message (200).

get.summary: One page of channel history in ascending order: newest page, or older ('before') / newer ('after') than a message ID.

delete.summary: Deletes a message (yours, or anyone's with ManageMessages). Leaves a tombstone.

post.summary: Starts an image upload and returns a short-lived URL to PUT the file to. Call complete afterwards.
Verifies an uploaded image (size, real format, dimensions) and makes it usable. Safe to retry.
Short-lived read URLs for up to 100 images the caller may view (avatars, icons of their communities).
